thread:
maria: Quick sync — Q3 roadmap decision needed for Private deploy: VPC control plane vs shipping on-prem package first. TL;DR: customers asking for air-gapped option, but packaging effort + SRE support is large.
chris: Agree. For Q3 we can do VPC CP GA, and start on-prem packaging alpha in Q4. But what about existing customers asking for airgap now? @sanjay
sanjay: A couple enterprise pilots need full air-gap by end of Q3 for compliance. Otherwise they stall procurement. Short timeline.
devon: If we push air-gap early we need: packaging distro, signed manifests, offline installer, KMS/HSM integration, and local telemetry opt-out. That's ~6-8 eng sprints.
amy: Also support footprint: we haven't finalized the onprem monitoring story. Ops will need a local aggregator or a push model. This affects rollout SLA commitments.
maria: OK tradeoffs: (A) VPC CP first — less infra risk, faster GA, meets many customers. (B) On-prem + airgap prioritized — meets strict compliance but delays GA and costs more eng/support.
kevin: Can we split scope? Minimal on-prem (control plane proxy + offline pkg v0) for pilots, full air-gap in later patch. That buys time.
chris: Technical constraints: air-gap requires packaging an offline model bundle. Model size + quantization affects installer size. Also licensing - need per-customer model entitlements.
sanjay: For pilots we can waive SLA and provide concierge deploy support. That reduces immediate support burden.
maria: Launch criteria proposals:
- VPC CP GA: runbook, e2e tests, canary in two regions, basic KMS support, SLA doc.
- On-prem alpha: offline installer, docs, one pilot customer deployed, degraded SLA.
kevin: OKRs alignment: prioritize tasks that unblock 2 paying pilots => move packaging alpha up. Otherwise prioritize VPC CP for broader revenue.
devon: Risks: if we delay air-gap, we lose enterprise deals. If we rush it, we risk expensive post-launch support.
maria: Decision call: do we approve split-path: VPC CP GA (Q3) + on-prem alpha for pilots (end Q3), full air-gap in Q4? vote pls.
chris: +1
sanjay: +1 (but need concierge commitment)
amy: +1
kevin: +1
devon: +1
maria: Cool. Action items:
- @chris scope VPC CP canary plan + SLOs (due 1912950400)
- @devon draft on-prem alpha checklist and eng estimate (due 1912876800)
- @sanjay draft pilot support SOW and concierge plan (due 1912790400)
- @amy assess monitoring options for offline installs (due 1912950400)
I'll compile for exec roadmap update.
